summary: Togo’s restoration commitments centre on 1,000,000 ha of reforestation, one billion trees by 2030 and a strengthened programme delivering 50,000 ha/year. The 1-million-ha goal equals about 40% of Togo’s current 24,856 km² forest area. Togo also targets 30% forest cover, restoration of at least 80% of degraded land by 2030, 20,000 ha of floodplain savanna, and mangrove and urban-forest restoration. Conservation combines protection of 578,000 ha of protected areas and corridors with a 5% reduction in burned vegetation and 30% lower deforestation. Agriculture emphasises climate-resilient zones on 500,000 ha, agroecology on 200,000 ha, conservation agriculture on 100,000 ha, SRI rice and community agroforestry on 50,000 ha each, irrigation, sustainable land management, and clean cooking for 500,000 households. The 500,000-ha zone programme covers about 19% of current 26,181 km² of agricultural area.
